choice_text.1784966484949348352: Why don't you try a crowbar?
choice_text.1784988203105792000: Why don't you try usin' your head for once? You see anywhere to wedge it in, huh?
choice_text.1784988581734002688: All right, all right, I'm just tryna help, jeez...
choice_text.1785078204850122752: Hey! Pst, pst, hey! Someone's comin'!
choice_text.1785111074687823872: I'm not blind! And shut your mouth!
choice_text.1785142432831254548: Hey, you lost or somethin'? Sorry, don't got a map. 'Ey, Rick! You got a map?
choice_text.1785169006163013632: Kinda hard when you're hoverin' over us, eh? Don't you got somewhere to be?
choice_text.1785172764880154624: What, th-this piece of junk? Yeah, psh, prolly nothin'.
choice_text.1785176152401391616: Mhm. Cans... uh, maybe bottles... heh, who knows?
choice_text.1785186057048961024: You from the lost and found or somethin'? 'Ey, if it isn't your biz, then don't go makin' it.
choice_text.1785211876026757120: Don't like it, don't buy it.
choice_text.1785214406349697024: Trust me – you won't get it open anyway.
choice_text.1785214911041908736: We'll see about that. Where'd you find it?
choice_text.1785229392212013056: That briefcase is more trouble than it's worth.
choice_text.1785238973696847872: It wasn't stolen. We found it.
choice_text.1785242711308251136: Look, it wasn't us, all right? Gonk was already cold! We swear!
choice_text.1785243341024276480: Wait, really? And here I had you pegged for top-tier mercs... Now, outta my way.
choice_text.1786870465443278848: How much to take it off your hands?
choice_text.1786873651604369408: Stuff like that doesn't just get lost. Won't find anything in there, 'cept trouble...
choice_text.1786875420023599104: How'd you find that? Doesn't take an expert to see it's corp-owned.
choice_text.1786877218474045440: Say what? You need to go get your heads checked.
choice_text.1789209086678675456: You know what? I'm done talking to you both.
choice_text.1795161717020438528: You just had to open your mouth, didn't ya?
choice_text.1824408347238084608: I'm short right now, but I'll be come up with somethin'.
choice_text.1855948169681186836: Well, look what we have here...
choice_text.1856356484890374152: Hoooly... it opened! We're fuckin' rich!
choice_text.1866471270948941824: Dumpsters... same place the shard was...
choice_text.1866473249637019648: Huh... and where are you meant to go...?
choice_text.1872208575200546816: Nope, used mine for smokes. Wherever you wanna be, sure as shit ain't here!
choice_text.1873276488149946368: Hey, hey, take it easy, boss... W-we can work something out, right? Come on...
choice_text.1873304416325783552: Whatever you say. Just know that whoever comes lookin'... won't be askin' questions.
choice_text.1873308717785862144: What're you waitin' for? Give it to 'im!
choice_text.1905345007024656384: Hear that? Nothin' for you here. Have a nice day, now.
choice_text.2015478026250539008: Fine... Take it... But, like, chill the fuck out, 'kay?

choice_text.1789372363937296384: Came here alone, no backup... probably a deal gone wrong.
choice_text.1789378210981621764: Let's see what we got here...
choice_text.1855953953139863552: Muscles aren't stiff yet... dead couple hours, tops.

choice_text.1792510487026610176: What... what the hell is this?
choice_text.1856215842042294272: I need two minutes. Keep your eyes peeled.
choice_text.1873374145472155648: What's it looks like? Brancesi, twenty twenty-one, "Untitled number eighteen," oil on canvas.
choice_text.1873375100817166336: But... what the hell was this doin' on the moon?
choice_text.1873375397304127492: What was this doing on the moon?
choice_text.1873376287117332480: Well, well. Who knew Johnny Silverhand's a lover of fine art?
choice_text.1873377613792464896: Not me – one of my exes. She was a painter. Bona fide psycho, like all of 'em. The sex, though... Can't even begin to describe it...
choice_text.1873378434936524800: Yeah, I'd really rather you didn't...
choice_text.1873379379443453952: Why else? Some bougie prick hung it on his wall. Half the Louvre's floating in space.
choice_text.1873383208641679360: Pah! With the chump change I got screamin' into a mic? Yeah, in my dreams...
choice_text.1873383990157955072: All right, let's bail before heads start rollin'. As for the painting... you'll have buyers linin' up in no time.
